description: This Java source file defines the ExceptionMapper class, which maps SSL-related exceptions to more meaningful Ditto-specific exceptions with detailed messages and headers. It includes methods for handling fatal errors and bad format errors, and wraps exception handling logic for SSL certificate and key store issues.
